read.en: Alphabet fell 1.6% on Oct 21 to $334.76, trading between $330.38 and $337.27. It is below all its averages: the falling 5-day ($341.8), 10-day ($346.3) and 100-day ($349.5), and the rising 200-day ($341.3) and 30-day ($345.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and is below zero, with the histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($357.79), and RSI is 40.
read.zh: Alphabet 10月21日下跌 1.6%，收于 $334.76，盘中区间 $330.38–337.27。股价位于全部均线下方：下行的 5 日（$341.8）、10 日（$346.3）和 100 日均线（$349.5），以及上行的 200 日（$341.3）和 30 日均线（$345.1）。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$357.79），RSI 为 40。

read.en: The close broke the $338.4 Oct 20 low and the $335.5 Oct 1 low, which now act as resistance. Resistance is $335.5–338.4, then $341.3–341.8 (200 and 5-day) and $345–346 (30 and 10-day). Support is $330.2–330.4 (day's low, Jun 26 low), then $327.7 (Sep 10 low) and $314.9 (Jul 23 low). A close below $327.7 would open $314.9; a close above $341.8 would target $346.

r.en: Oct 1 low $335.5 and Oct 20 low $338.4, now resistance
